Nightmare Before Christmas Jack Skellington Mug Arrives at Trader Sam's Grog Grotto

By WDWMAGIC Staff · Tuesday November 17, 2026 5:51pm ET · "Trader Sam's Grog Grotto"
A new Jack Skellington mug arrives at Trader Sam's Grog Grotto and the Polynesian lobby, served with the Pumpkin King, a chai and pumpkin spice drink with coconut.
Add WDWMAGIC on Google See more of our stories in Google Top Stories and Discover.
Add to Preferred Sources on Google
Forum Forums Tweet Share Tweet Share

Photos / 1 in this gallery

Nightmare Before Christmas Jack Skellington Mug Mug

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:16
Instaread

A new Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas Jack Skellington Mug is now available at Disney's Polynesian Village Resort. You can pick it up with a drink in the first-floor lobby or at Trader Sam's Grog Grotto.

Photo: DisneyNightmare Before Christmas Jack Skellington Mug Mug

The mug shows Jack in his Pumpkin King pose, arms raised, with white ghosts rising up behind him against a bright red background. The bottom of the mug is shaped like a stitched burlap sack tied with rope.

The Pumpkin King Drink

The mug comes with the Pumpkin King, a drink made with:

  • Cranberry juice
  • Lime juice
  • Cream of coconut
  • DOLE Pineapple Juice
  • Chai and pumpkin spice flavors

Where to Get the Jack Skellington Mug

  • First-floor lobby, Disney's Polynesian Village Resort
  • Trader Sam's Grog Grotto, Disney's Polynesian Village Resort

Trader Sam's is a small lounge and often has a wait, especially in the evening. Arrive close to opening for a better chance of getting in quickly. If you only want the mug, the lobby location is the easier option.

Disney hasn't shared how long the mug will be available. Specialty mugs like this often sell out, so plan to go early in your trip if you want one.
